title: Western Lake House | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked into the desirable Camp District of WaterColor, this beautifully updated four-bedroom, four-bathroom retreat—with a private carriage house—offers the perfect blend of laid-back luxury and family-friendly comfort. Just steps from Camp WaterColor and the lazy river, the home sits on a prime corner lot surrounded by natural greenery and directly across from a serene park and bocce ball lawn. A welcoming wraparound porch with cozy seating and a twin bed swing sets the tone, while inside, an open-concept layout connects the stylish kitchen, dining, and living areas for easy gatherings. With high-end appliances, thoughtful touches like a wet bar and Sonos system, and a golf cart ready for beach club adventures, every detail is designed for effortless vacation living. The heart of the home lies in its spacious screened-in porch—complete with an outdoor kitchen, beverage fridge, and TV—ideal for alfresco dinners or unwinding after a beach day. The main house features three well-appointed bedrooms, including a serene upstairs primary suite with a spa-like bath and office nook, while the private carriage house offers a separate king suite with its own kitchen and laundry, perfect for extended family or guests. From breezy mornings on the porch to sunset rides on the included cruiser bikes, this WaterColor gem delivers an unforgettable 30A escape filled with relaxation, style, and coastal charm.
